landing.problemDesc: As a student, you struggle to find study materials. You search through scattered WhatsApp and Telegram groups, waste time looking for a single file, and find files unorganized without clear categorization.

landing.chapter1Text1: It all started with a simple problem: students searching for summaries before exams, wasting hours looking for a single file.
landing.chapter1Text2: We said: 'Why not bring everything together in one place?' And that's how the Fyleo idea was born.
landing.chapter2Text1: Students were suffering from file chaos. WhatsApp groups, Google Drive folders, Telegram files... each student had a different system.
landing.chapter2Text2: And every time you look for a file, you waste half an hour. There has to be a better solution!
landing.chapter3Text1: We built Fyleo - a smart digital library that brings all study materials together in one place. Organized, easy, and fast.
landing.chapter3Text2: Advanced search, classification by subject and topic, and everything is 100% free.

about.title: About Fyleo
about.subtitle: An open-source educational platform for sharing knowledge and educational materials
about.missionText: We strive to provide a free and secure platform that enables students to share educational materials and exchange knowledge easily and systematically, with full commitment to intellectual property rights and Jordanian laws.
about.feature1Desc: Thousands of educational files organized by subject and level
about.feature2Desc: Advanced search system for quick access to required materials
about.feature3Desc: Fast downloads with complete protection of your personal data
about.feature4Desc: All services are free without any fees or advertisements
about.teamText: A team of developers and students passionate about providing the best free educational experience for everyone
about.contactText: Have a question or suggestion? We're here to help!

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.intro: The information and materials available on the Fyleo platform ("Information System" and "Information Network" as defined in the Jordanian Cybercrime Law) are provided by platform users and are for educational and knowledge exchange purposes only.

section1.title: 1. Platform Nature and User Role
section1.content: Fyleo is an educational platform that operates as a "Service Provider" as defined in the Cybercrime Law. We only provide the technical infrastructure, while content is created and uploaded by users.
section1.userContentDesc: All files, posts, and links available on the platform are uploaded and shared by registered users
section1.technicalRoleDesc: We provide file storage system (MinIO + Oracle Cloud), database (Appwrite), and authentication system only
section1.noReviewDesc: We do not review or inspect content before publication, but respond to reports immediately

section2.title: 2. Content Accuracy and Reliability
section2.content: Fyleo does not guarantee the accuracy, completeness, or usefulness of any files, links, or published information:
section2.personalOpinionsDesc: All content expresses the opinions of its publishers from users and not necessarily the opinion of the platform or its management
section2.noVerificationDesc: We do not verify the accuracy of published academic or scientific information
section2.updatesDesc: Content may be outdated or not updated, and we do not guarantee its update
section2.errorsDesc: Content may contain scientific errors or inaccurate information

section3.title: 3. External Links and Websites
section3.content: The platform may contain links to external websites ("Website" in the legal sense):
section3.easeOfAccessDesc: These links are available for ease of user access only
section3.noResponsibilityDesc: Fyleo is not responsible for the content, privacy policies, or practices of those sites
section3.linkCheckDesc: We use Google Safe Browsing API to check links, but do not guarantee the safety of all links
section3.personalResponsibilityDesc: Visiting any external site is at your own risk

section4.title: 4. Use at Your Own Risk
section4.content: Your use of or reliance on any content through the platform is at your own personal risk:
section4.academicDecisionsDesc: Do not rely on published content for important academic decisions without verification from official sources
section4.examsDesc: Content does not replace official references and textbooks approved by the university
section4.copyrightsDesc: Ensure that your use of content does not violate intellectual property rights
section4.damagesDesc: Fyleo disclaims responsibility for any material or moral losses or damages that may result from using the content

section5.title: 5. Intellectual Property Rights
section5.userResponsibilityDesc: The user who uploads content is responsible for ensuring no copyright infringement
section5.reportResponseDesc: We respond immediately to any copyright infringement report and delete violating content within 48 hours
section5.fairUseDesc: Published content must be for educational purposes within the principle of "fair use"
section5.reportingDesc: If you find content that violates your rights, please report it immediately via

section6.title: 6. Security and Viruses
section6.fileCheckDesc: We check file types (File Type Validation) but do not guarantee they are free from viruses or malware
section6.antivirusSoftwareDesc: We strongly recommend using antivirus software before opening any file
section6.safeDownloadDesc: Make sure to download files from trusted sources only

section7.title: 7. Availability and Technical Performance
section7.noAvailabilityGuaranteeDesc: We do not guarantee that the platform will be available 24/7 without interruption
section7.maintenanceDesc: We may temporarily suspend service for maintenance or updates
section7.technicalErrorsDesc: Technical errors or performance issues may occur
section7.dataLossDesc: We recommend keeping backup copies of your important files

warningBox.title: Important Legal Notice
warningBox.content: Content available on the platform is provided by users and for educational purposes only:
warningBox.point1: You must verify the accuracy of information before relying on it for any academic or professional decisions
warningBox.point2: You are legally responsible for any content you publish according to the Jordanian Cybercrime Law
warningBox.point3: Using the platform means you agree to take full responsibility for your actions
warningBox.point4: In case of any violating content, please report it immediately

privacy.title: Fyleo Platform Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Your privacy matters to us. This policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal information when you use the Fyleo platform ("Service") in accordance with the Electronic Transactions Law and Personal Data Protection Law in the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan.

section1.title: 1. Information We Collect
section1.content: We collect the following types of information ("Data" as defined in the Cybercrime Law):
section1.personalInfoDesc: Name and email when creating an account. Your password is handled and stored securely and encrypted (Hashed using Bcrypt algorithm) and we cannot access it in any way.
section1.autoCollectedDesc: We collect and store your Internet Protocol (IP Address) and "traffic data route" (login dates and times) in server logs. This is done for security purposes only, such as protection from unauthorized use, diagnosing technical problems, and cooperating with authorities when needed.
section1.uploadedContentDesc: Educational files and posts you share on the platform, including metadata such as file name, size, file type, and upload date.

section2.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
section2.content: We use your information for the following purposes:
section2.point1: Creating and managing your account on the platform
section2.point2: Communicating with you about important matters related to your account
section2.point3: Maintaining platform security and safety and preventing unauthorized use
section2.point4: Complying with legal requirements and cooperating with competent authorities
section2.point5: Improving service quality and fixing technical errors

section3.title: 3. Cookies
section3.content: We use cookies for necessary purposes only:
section3.sessionCookiesDesc: To keep your login session active while browsing the platform
section3.authTokensDesc: To authenticate your identity securely with each request
section3.noteDesc: We do not use cookies for tracking, advertising, or marketing analytics purposes.

section4.title: 4. Data Storage and Technical Infrastructure
section4.content: We use reliable services to store your data securely:
section4.appwriteDesc: We use the open-source Appwrite platform to manage databases and login authentication. All data is encrypted in transit (TLS/SSL) and at rest (Encryption at Rest).
section4.oracleDesc: Files you upload are stored on Oracle Cloud servers using MinIO system. Each file gets a unique identifier (UUID) and is stored securely with specific access permissions.
section4.analyticsDesc: We do not use any external analytics tools (such as Google Analytics or Facebook Pixel) to track visitor behavior on the platform.
section4.dataSharingDesc: We do not sell, rent, or share your personal information with any third parties for marketing or advertising purposes.

section5.title: 🔐 5. Security and Encryption
section5.content: We take strict security measures to protect your data:
section5.passwordEncryptionDesc: Using Bcrypt with high Salt Factor
section5.httpsDesc: All communications are encrypted using TLS 1.3 protocol
section5.accessControlDesc: Specific access permissions for each user (Role-Based Access Control)
section5.fileValidationDesc: Checking all uploaded files for safety

section6.title: 6. Data Retention and Storage Duration
section6.content: We retain your data for the following periods:
section6.accountDataDesc: As long as your account is active, or until you request deletion
section6.uploadedFilesDesc: Until you delete them or delete your account
section6.legalDataDesc: We may retain some data for a longer period if required by court order

section7.title: ⚖️ 7. Cooperation with Authorities (Legally Mandatory)
section7.content: According to the Jordanian Cybercrime Law, we are committed to full cooperation with competent authorities. In case of an official request from the Public Prosecutor, judicial, or security authorities, we will provide:
section7.activityLogsDesc: IP addresses ("Protocol Address"), login dates and times ("traffic data route")
section7.publishedContentDesc: Copies of reported files or posts
section7.metadataDesc: Information about uploaded files and interactions
section7.noteDesc: We will not share any data except by official court order or request from a competent government authority.

section8.title: 8. Your Personal Data Rights
section8.content: You have the following rights regarding your personal data:
section8.accessRightDesc: You can request a copy of all your personal data
section8.correctionRightDesc: You can modify your account information at any time
section8.deletionRightDesc: You can permanently delete your account and all your data through the settings page
section8.objectionRightDesc: You can object to processing your data for certain purposes
section8.portabilityRightDesc: You can request a copy of your data in a readable format
section8.contactInfo: To do any of this, please contact us via email:

section9.title: 9. Account and Data Deletion
section9.content: When you delete your account, we will delete:
section9.point1: All your personal data from the database
section9.point2: All files you uploaded from storage servers (MinIO)
section9.noteDesc: We may retain some anonymous data for statistical purposes or if legally required.

section10.title: 10. Privacy Policy Updates
section10.content: We may update this policy from time to time. We will notify you of any material changes via email or through a notice on the platform. Your continued use of the platform after updates means you agree to the updated policy.

terms.title: Fyleo Platform Terms of Service
terms.intro: Welcome to Fyleo. By using our platform ("Service"), you agree to comply with these terms and conditions ("Terms") and all applicable laws in the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan, including Cybercrime Law No. (17) of 2023 and Electronic Transactions Law.

section1.title: 1. Legal Eligibility (Minimum Age)
section1.content: You must be at least 18 years old to create an account and use this service. By using the platform, you acknowledge and warrant that you are at least 18 years old and have full legal capacity to agree to these terms and comply with Jordanian laws.

section2.title: 2. Service Description
section2.content: Fyleo is an electronic educational platform, open source, aimed at enabling users to share educational files and study resources ("Content") for purely educational purposes. The platform operates as an "Information System" and "Information Network" as defined in the Jordanian Cybercrime Law.

section3.title: 3. User Responsibility and Content
section3.content: You alone are fully responsible for any content you upload or share. You acknowledge that you own all necessary rights that allow you to share this content, and that your content does not violate any applicable laws in the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan.
section3.legalCommitmentDesc: Under the Jordanian Cybercrime Law, you are legally responsible for any content you publish, and may be held legally accountable in case of publishing violating content.

section4.title: ⚠️ 4. Prohibited Content (Legally Mandatory)
section4.content: According to Jordanian Cybercrime Law No. (17) of 2023, it is strictly prohibited to publish or share any content that includes:
section4.pornographicDesc: Any content related to prostitution, obscenity, or violating public decency (Article 14 - Penalty: 6 months + 9,000-15,000 dinars)
section4.falseNewsDesc: Publishing false or misleading information targeting national security or community peace (Article 15 - Penalty: 3 months + 5,000-20,000 dinars)
section4.defamationDesc: Any content including insult, defamation, or character assassination (Articles 15 & 16 - Penalty: 3 months + 5,000-20,000 dinars)
section4.incitementDesc: Content that incites sectarian or ethnic tensions or promotes hatred or violence (Article 17 - Penalty: 1-3 years + 5,000-20,000 dinars)
section4.extortionDesc: Any attempt to blackmail or threaten others (Article 18 - Penalty: 1 year + 3,000-6,000 dinars)
section4.extremistDesc: Promoting weapons, explosives, or extremist ideas (Article 19 - Penalty: 2 years + 10,000-30,000 dinars)
section4.privacyViolationDesc: Publishing private photos or videos without permission (Article 20 - Penalty: 3 months + 20,000-40,000 dinars)

section5.title: 5. Copyright Policy (Report and Remove)
section5.content: We respect intellectual property rights in accordance with Jordanian Copyright Protection Law. If you believe content violates your rights, please send a detailed report including:
section5.point1: Accurate description of the infringed work
section5.point2: Link to content on the platform
section5.commitment: We commit to reviewing reports and removing violating content within 48 hours of receiving the report.

section6.title: 🚫 6. Commercial Promotion and Paid Advertising Ban (Red Line)
section6.content: Fyleo platform is a completely free educational platform aimed at knowledge exchange without any financial compensation. It is strictly prohibited to use the platform for the following purposes:
section6.paidCoursesDesc: Any content promoting paid training courses or courses whether online or offline
section6.personalAdsDesc: Promoting personal paid services, private lessons, paid consultations, or any commercial activity
section6.promoLinksDesc: Publishing links to commercial sites, paid course platforms (Udemy, Coursera, etc. for personal profit), or any marketing content
section6.platformExploitationDesc: Using the platform as a means to reach students for commercial or personal profit purposes
section6.conditionalContentDesc: Publishing educational content then directing users to pay for "full version" or "advanced content"

penalties.title: ⚠️ Penalties and Actions:
penalties.firstDesc: Immediate deletion of violating content + official warning
penalties.multipleDesc: Permanent account cancellation without possibility of recovery
penalties.severeDesc: Immediate account cancellation + IP ban + reporting to competent authorities if necessary

section6.purposeDesc: Providing completely free educational content for everyone without any commercial exploitation. We respect and appreciate contributors' efforts, but this does not mean turning the platform into a personal profit tool. Knowledge should be available to everyone for free.

section7.title: 7. Cooperation with Authorities
section7.content: We are committed to full cooperation with Jordanian competent authorities. In case of an official request from the Public Prosecutor or judicial authorities, we will provide:
section7.activityLogsDesc: IP addresses, login dates, published content
section7.violatingContentDesc: Copies of reported files or posts

section8.title: 8. Disclaimer of Warranties
section8.content: The service is provided "as is" and "as available" without warranties of any kind. We do not guarantee that the service will be secure, error-free, or that content available on it is accurate or reliable. Published content expresses opinions of its publishers and not necessarily the opinion of the platform.

section9.title: 9. Limitation of Liability
section9.content: In no event shall Fyleo owner be liable for any direct or indirect damages arising from your use or inability to use the service, or from any content obtained through it. User bears full legal responsibility for their actions on the platform.

section10.content: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate your account immediately and without prior notice in case of:
section10.point3: Promoting paid services or commercial courses (red line)
section10.point5: Using the platform for illegal or commercial purposes
